summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container. Changes: Update class in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py now returns Update(prologue, res) on every path, building the prologue from q.prologue[0] on the empty-request branch; evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added to processor.py and exported from rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py; new test module test/test_sparql_prepare.py with 11 tests. Nothing was run and nothing was committed, so the new tests and the existing prepareQuery and DAWG suites are unverified. Points to check when running: parseUpdate("") and declarations-only input must yield one prologue group; the repr-based no-mutation snapshot depends on CompValue repr being stable; test_dawg.py line 322 passes the container to pprintAlgebra inside a bare try/except, so that debug output may change.
